petting-kiko-without-a-catspeak-amulet.text: You pet the cat, who leans into your hand in return.

petting-kiko-with-a-catspeak-amulet.npc: Can you scratch my belly next? It's perfectly safe.

giving-kiko-raw-fish-without-a-catspeak-.text: Kiko happily gobbles up the fish.

giving-kiko-raw-fish-with-a-catspeak-amu.npc: Ooh, thank you. Did you catch this yourself?

using-other-items-on-kiko.text: The cat takes no interest in what you have to offer him.
